# browserjs_sessions (Data Source)

Every session of the API token's owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "browserjs_sessions" "all" {}

output "session_names" {
  value = [for s in data.browserjs_sessions.all.sessions : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sessions` (Attributes List) The sessions, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The session ID.
- `mcp_url` (String) What an MCP client is pointed at.
- `name` (String) The session's name.
- `owner` (String) Who owns the session.
- `state` (String) The session's state as the API reports it.
